By the time the lantern is lit, the damage has been done. Nobody will ever know what you intended, or why a famous detective was in the bed, or why a doctor lay across the window-sill with his hands upon his face. The inquest is open for a week. Dr Roylott gives evidence in a soft, grave, grieving voice, and the coroner thanks him for his courage.
